note: Schema fidelity for serde attributes that change the wire shape. New #[schema(value_type = T)] documents a field (or, on the struct / enum, the whole type) with T's schema. A field converted by #[serde(with / serialize_with / deserialize_with)] without value_type is documented as any value ({}) with a description instead of its Rust type (a ts_seconds DateTime was documented as a date-time string but is an integer); one-sided serialize_with / deserialize_with only affect that direction, and an Option read by a custom deserializer is required in requests. Container #[serde(into = "T")] documents responses as T and from / try_from documents requests ({Name}Input) as T. The derive's Schema assertion checks value_type instead of the field type. SeaORM Json / JsonValue columns are {} (any JSON value) instead of type: object, schema_type! maps JsonValue to serde_json::Value, and Json<T> with a type argument stays axum's wrapper.
